title: Take ObjectGenericODE1 with a symbolic rhsUserFunction into SymbolicSystem
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-28 (make SymbolicSystem take ODE1 items and joints): nODE1, InitialStateODE1 and ODE1RightHandSide from ObjectGenericODE1 - its systemMatrix, rhsVector and a symbolic rhsUserFunction - grouped in kinds as the ODE2 objects, the LTG maps of GetObjectLTGODE1; ODE1 coordinates no longer refused. A test model against SolveDynamic with SolveExplicit and SolveGeneralizedAlpha.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SymbolicSystem takes ObjectGenericODE1 with its systemMatrix, rhsVector and a symbolic rhsUserFunction, and LoadCoordinate on ODE1 coordinates: ODE1RightHandSide, the exact ODE1Jacobian and InitialStateODE1; SolveGeneralizedAlpha and SolveExplicit integrate such systems as SolveDynamic does.
